CLAUDE.md\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThis file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Project Overview\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nCodex is an AI coding assistant platform forked from OpenAI/codex with extensive enhancements (zapabob extensions). The core is a Rust workspace (&#96;codex-rs/&#96;) with 69 crates, plus a Next.js GUI (&#96;gui/&#96;), a Node.js CLI (&#96;codex-cli/&#96;), and supporting services.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**Version**: 2.16.0 | **Rust edition**: 2024 | **Toolchain**: 1.93.0\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Build &amp; Development Commands\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Rust (primary — all commands run from &#96;codex-rs/&#96;)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\\\\\\\\n# Task runner (just) — working directory is automatically set to codex-rs/\\\\\\\\njust fmt                        # Format code (cargo fmt with imports_granularity=Item)\\\\\\\\njust clippy                     # Lint all crates\\\\\\\\njust fix -p &lt;crate&gt;             # Auto-fix clippy issues for a specific crate\\\\\\\\njust test                       # Run all tests with cargo-nextest\\\\\\\\njust install                    # Fetch dependencies, show active toolchain\\\\\\\\njust codex                      # Run codex from source (cargo run --bin codex)\\\\\\\\njust exec \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"prompt\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"              # Run codex exec mode\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n# Direct cargo commands (from codex-rs/)\\\\\\\\ncargo build --release -p codex-cli          # Release build of CLI\\\\\\\\ncargo install --path cli --force            # Install globally\\\\\\\\ncargo test -p codex-tui                     # Test a single crate\\\\\\\\ncargo test --all-features -p codex-core     # Test with all features\\\\\\\\ncargo nextest run --no-fail-fast            # Fast test runner (preferred)\\\\\\\\ncargo clippy -p codex-cli -- -D warnings    # Lint a specific crate\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n# Snapshot tests (TUI uses insta)\\\\\\\\ncargo test -p codex-tui                     # Generate .snap.new files\\\\\\\\ncargo insta pending-snapshots -p codex-tui  # Review pending\\\\\\\\ncargo insta accept -p codex-tui             # Accept snapshots\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n# Dependency checks\\\\\\\\ncargo shear                                 # Find unused dependencies\\\\\\\\ncargo deny check                            # License/security audit\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Windows fast-build scripts (from codex-rs/)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\\\\\\\\n.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ultra-fast-build-install.ps1   # Fastest incremental build\\\\\\\\n.\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\clean-build-install.ps1        # Clean rebuild\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Bazel (alternative build system)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\\\\\\\\njust bazel-codex                # Run codex via Bazel\\\\\\\\njust bazel-test                 # Run all Bazel tests\\\\\\\\njust bazel-remote-test          # Run tests with remote execution\\\\\\\\njust build-for-release          # Remote release builds\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### GUI (Next.js — from gui/)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\\\\\\\\nnpm run dev          # Dev server (0.0.0.0)\\\\\\\\nnpm run build        # Production build\\\\\\\\nnpm run lint         # ESLint\\\\\\\\nnpm test             # Playwright E2E tests\\\\\\\\nnpm run test:headed  # Headed browser tests\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Root-level formatting (from repo root)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\\\\\\\\npnpm run format      # Prettier check (JSON, MD, YAML, JS)\\\\\\\\npnpm run format:fix  # Prettier auto-fix\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Architecture\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Rust Workspace (&#96;codex-rs/&#96;)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThe workspace follows a layered architecture. Key crates and their roles:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;cli&#96;** — Binary entry point (&#96;codex&#96;). Subcommands: interactive TUI, &#96;exec&#96;, &#96;delegate&#96;, &#96;agent-create&#96;, &#96;research&#96;, &#96;resume&#96;, etc.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;tui&#96;** — Terminal UI built with ratatui. Renders chat, execution cells, slash commands. Uses insta for snapshot testing.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;core&#96;** — Central orchestration engine. Contains:\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;agents/runtime.rs&#96; — Sub-agent execution runtime\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;codex.rs&#96; — Main Codex session lifecycle\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;orchestration/&#96; — Resource management, task coordination\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;tools/&#96; — Tool specs and execution (shell, file ops, etc.)\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;mcp_dynamic_loader/&#96; — Dynamic MCP server loading\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;models_manager/&#96; — Model family detection, presets, capabilities\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;sandboxing/&#96; — Platform-specific sandbox (macOS: Seatbelt, Linux: Landlock+seccomp, Windows: Job Objects)\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;backend-client&#96;** — HTTP client for OpenAI API. Handles SSE streaming, retries, auth.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;protocol&#96;** — Wire protocol types shared between CLI/TUI and app-server.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;app-server&#96;** — WebSocket/SSE server for GUI communication. Implements &#96;app-server-protocol&#96;.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;app-server-protocol&#96;** — Schema definitions (v2 protocol) for GUI&lt;-&gt;server communication. Has &#96;write_schema_fixtures&#96; binary to regenerate vendored schemas.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;mcp-server&#96;** — Codex as an MCP server for external tool integration.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;config&#96;** — Configuration types (&#96;~/.codex/config.toml&#96; schema). Has &#96;codex-write-config-schema&#96; binary.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;state&#96;** — SQLite-backed session/state persistence (via sqlx).\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;exec&#96; / &#96;exec-server&#96;** — Command execution layer.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;deep-research&#96;** — Multi-source research with citations.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;supervisor&#96;** — Agent supervision and lifecycle management.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;windows-sandbox-rs&#96;** / &#96;linux-sandbox&#96; / &#96;process-hardening&#96; — Platform sandboxing.\\\\\\\\n- **&#96;utils/&#96;** — Shared utilities (paths, git, caching, sanitization, fuzzy-match, etc.).\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Data Flow\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\nUser → CLI/TUI → Core Runtime → Backend Client → OpenAI API\\\\\\\\n                      ↓\\\\\\\\n              MCP Servers ← Tool Execution ← Sandbox Layer\\\\\\\\n                      ↓\\\\\\\\n              App Server → GUI (WebSocket/SSE)\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### GUI (&#96;gui/&#96;)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nNext.js 14 app with React, MUI 7, Three.js for 3D visualization, WebXR for VR/AR support. Communicates with the Rust app-server over WebSocket.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Sub-Agent System (&#96;.codex/agents/&#96;)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nYAML-defined specialized agents (code-reviewer, test-gen, sec-audit, researcher, etc.) with token budgets and sandbox policies. Executed via &#96;codex delegate&#96; or &#96;codex delegate-parallel&#96;.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Coding Conventions\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Rust\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Clippy is strict**: &#96;unwrap_used&#96; and &#96;expect_used&#96; are denied (allowed in tests). See workspace lints in &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96;.\\\\\\\\n- Use inline format args: &#96;println!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"User {name}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")&#96; not &#96;println!(\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"User {}\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", name)&#96; (&#96;uninlined_format_args = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"deny\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"&#96;).\\\\\\\\n- Prefer iterators/method references over explicit loops/closures (&#96;redundant_closure_for_method_calls = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"deny\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"&#96;).\\\\\\\\n- TUI colors: Use ANSI colors only. &#96;Color::Rgb&#96;, &#96;Color::Indexed&#96;, hardcoded white/black/yellow are disallowed in clippy.toml.\\\\\\\\n- Enhanced thresholds: max 5 function args, cognitive complexity 15, max 300 lines/function, error size 128 bytes.\\\\\\\\n- &#96;unsafe&#96;, &#96;transmute&#96;, &#96;null&#96;, &#96;uninitialized&#96;, &#96;zeroed&#96; are disallowed.\\\\\\\\n- Format: &#96;cargo fmt&#96; with &#96;edition = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"2024\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"&#96;. The &#96;imports_granularity = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Item\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"&#96; flag is passed via &#96;just fmt&#96; but not in rustfmt.toml (unstable).\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### TypeScript/JavaScript\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Prettier: printWidth=80, semi=true, trailingComma=\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"all\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", tabWidth=2.\\\\\\\\n- No &#96;any&#96; types, no &#96;var&#96;. Use &#96;const&#96; default, &#96;async/await&#96; over &#96;.then()&#96;.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Integration tests\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Use &#96;pretty_assertions::assert_eq&#96; for better diffs.\\\\\\\\n- Use &#96;core_test_support::responses&#96; helpers for mock SSE responses.\\\\\\\\n- TUI: snapshot tests with &#96;insta&#96;.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Sandbox Modes\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThree security levels available via &#96;--sandbox&#96; flag:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n| Mode | Description |\\\\\\\\n|------|-------------|\\\\\\\\n| &#96;read-only&#96; | Default. Read files only. |\\\\\\\\n| &#96;workspace-write&#96; | Write within workspace directory. |\\\\\\\\n| &#96;danger-full-access&#96; | Full system access (requires explicit opt-in). |\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Environment Variables\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\nOPENAI_API_KEY     — Required for API access\\\\\\\\nRUST_LOG           — Log level (e.g., \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"info\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\nCODEX_CONFIG_PATH  — Override config location (default: ~/.codex/config.toml)\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Regenerating Schemas\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\\\\\\\\njust write-config-schema         # Regenerate config.toml JSON schema\\\\\\\\njust write-app-server-schema     # Regenerate app-server protocol schema\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## CI\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nGitHub Actions workflows run: multi-platform Rust builds (Linux/macOS/Windows, x64/ARM64), clippy, fmt, nextest, cargo-deny, codespell, Bazel tests, Playwright GUI tests, and security audits. The &#96;imports_granularity = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Item\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"&#96; flag is passed via &#96;just fmt&#96; but not in rustfmt.toml (unstable).\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### TypeScript/JavaScript\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Prettier: printWidth=80, semi=true, trailingComma=\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"all\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", tabWidth=2.\\\\\\\\n- No &#96;any&#96; types, no &#96;var&#96;. Use &#96;const&#96; default, &#96;async/await&#96; over &#96;.then()&#96;.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Integration tests\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- Use &#96;pretty_assertions::assert_eq&#96; for better diffs.\\\\\\\\n- Use &#96;core_test_support::responses&#96; helpers for mock SSE responses.\\\\\\\\n- TUI: snapshot tests with &#96;insta&#96;.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Sandbox Modes\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThree security levels available via &#96;--sandbox&#96; flag:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n| Mode | Description |\\\\\\\\n|------|-------------|\\\\\\\\n| &#96;read-only&#96; | Default. Read files only. |\\\\\\\\n| &#96;workspace-write&#96; | Write within workspace directory. |\\\\\\\\n| &#96;danger-full-access&#96; | Full system access (requires explicit opt-in). |\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Environment Variables\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\nOPENAI_API_KEY     — Required for API access\\\\\\\\nRUST_LOG           — Log level (e.g., \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"info\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"debug\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\")\\\\\\\\nCODEX_CONFIG_PATH  — Override config location (default: ~/.codex/config.toml)\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Regenerating Schemas\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\\\\\\\\njust write-config-schema         # Regenerate config.toml JSON schema\\\\\\\\njust write-app-server-schema     # Regenerate app-server protocol schema\\\\\\\\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## CI\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nGitHub Actions workflows run: multi-platform Rust builds (Linux/macOS/Windows, x64/ARM64), clippy, fmt, nextest, cargo-deny, codespell, Bazel tests, Playwright GUI tests, and security audits. Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),\\\\\\\\nand this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## [2.16.0] - 2026-02-13 - \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Upstream Sync &amp; Security Hardening\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🚀 Major Features\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**This release merges 226 upstream commits from openai/codex, incorporating the latest security fixes, bug fixes, and new features while preserving all custom zapabob extensions.**\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### ✅ Added (from upstream)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Apps MCP Gateway** (&#96;apps_mcp_gateway&#96;) - New gateway for apps integration\\\\\\\\n- **Shell Tool MCP** - Patched zsh build pipeline for improved shell execution\\\\\\\\n- **Thread/List CWD** - Added &#96;cwd&#96; as optional field to thread/list API\\\\\\\\n- **Feature Flags Testing** - Verify enabled-by-default feature flags are stable\\\\\\\\n- **TurnContextItem Persistence** - Complete state persisted via canonical conversion\\\\\\\\n- **Approvals Scenarios** - More comprehensive approval workflow testing\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🔒 Security (from upstream)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **DNS Rebinding Fix** - Resolved DNS rebinding vulnerability in network proxy\\\\\\\\n- **Sandbox Bypass Fix** - Fixed sandbox bypass vulnerability\\\\\\\\n- **Exec Policy Path Confusion** - Resolved path confusion in exec policy\\\\\\\\n- **Case-Insensitivity Vulnerability** - Fixed case-insensitive matching exploit\\\\\\\\n- **Git Command Safety** - Removed git commands from dangerous command checks\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🐛 Fixed (from upstream)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **NUX Display** - Don't show NUX for upgrade-target models that are hidden\\\\\\\\n- **App Loading Logic** - Fixed app loading sequence\\\\\\\\n- **TUI Improvements** - Delta streaming, compaction events, approvals UI\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 📦 Preserved Custom Features (zapabob)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- &#96;codex-gui-x/&#96; - Custom GUI implementation\\\\\\\\n- &#96;prism-mcp-server/&#96;, &#96;prism-web/&#96; - Prism MCP integrations\\\\\\\\n- WebXR Git visualization with cyberpunk effects\\\\\\\\n- AI tool orchestration (task distribution, result integration)\\\\\\\\n- Bilingual README and GH Pages\\\\\\\\n- Fast build system and hot reload installation\\\\\\\\n- CI/CD customizations and release packaging\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🔧 Technical Details\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Merge Strategy**: &#96;git merge upstream/main&#96; with Python-automated conflict resolution\\\\\\\\n- **Conflicts Resolved**: 51 files (0 failures)\\\\\\\\n- **Upstream Commits Merged**: 226\\\\\\\\n- **Files Changed**: 594 files (+41,384 / -11,057 lines)\\\\\\\\n- **Module Restructuring**: &#96;codex-rs/common/&#96; merged into &#96;codex-rs/utils/cli/&#96;, hooks module restructured\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 📈 Dependencies\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- pnpm 10.28.2, node &gt;=22\\\\\\\\n- Various Cargo dependency updates (axum, clap, tokio, etc.)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n---\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## [2.9.0] - 2026-01-04 - \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Fast Build &amp; Hot Reload System\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🚀 Major Features\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**This release introduces a complete build and deployment pipeline overhaul with hot reload capabilities and integrated release packaging.**\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### ✅ Added\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Fast Incremental Build System (&#96;scripts/fast_build.py&#96;)**\\\\\\\\n  - MD5 hash-based change detection for intelligent rebuilds\\\\\\\\n  - Cargo incremental compilation optimization\\\\\\\\n  - Parallel build processing with CPU core utilization\\\\\\\\n  - tqdm-powered progress visualization\\\\\\\\n  - Build cache persistence (&#96;.build_cache.pkl&#96;)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Hot Reload Installation System (&#96;scripts/build_and_install.py&#96;)**\\\\\\\\n  - Cross-platform process detection and termination (psutil)\\\\\\\\n  - Atomic binary replacement with safety checks\\\\\\\\n  - Platform-specific installation (Windows/macOS/Linux)\\\\\\\\n  - Installation verification with version checking\\\\\\\\n  - PowerShell integration for Windows deployment\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Integrated Release Packaging**\\\\\\\\n  - GitHub Actions workflow for cross-platform tgz packages\\\\\\\\n  - All-platform binaries in single downloadable archive\\\\\\\\n  - Automated install script generation (&#96;install.sh&#96;)\\\\\\\\n  - Comprehensive release documentation (&#96;INSTALL.md&#96;)\\\\\\\\n  - Release notes with installation instructions\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Development Tools Enhancement**\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;just fast-build&#96; - Quick incremental builds\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;just build-install&#96; - Full pipeline execution\\\\\\\\n  - &#96;just install-kill&#96; - Direct binary replacement\\\\\\\\n  - Process-safe deployment with zero-downtime updates\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🎯 Performance Improvements\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Build Speed**: Up to 70% faster incremental builds with change detection\\\\\\\\n- **Deployment Time**: Instant hot reload with process Codex機能拡張統合の要求仕様書\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 背景\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nOpenAIが提供する「Codex」は、ターミナル上で動作する軽量のコーディングエージェントであり、対話を通じてコードの生成・編集やテスト実行など開発支援を行います 。現行のOpenAI版Codex（以下「本家Codex」）は、VS CodeやCursorといったIDEとの連携、GitHubプルリクエストレビュー機能、シングルスレッドでの非同期タスク実行、Web/ターミナル統合といった基本機能を備えています 。一方で、コミュニティにおける派生版であるzapabob氏のCodex（以下「zapabob版Codex」）では、本家Codexにはない高度な機能拡張が多数実装されています 。主な相違点として、zapabob版Codexはエージェントのオーケストレーション（編成管理）方法に革新的な改良が加えられており、複数エージェントの並列実行や動的生成、エージェント自身による自己呼び出し（メタオーケストレーション）などを可能にしています 。またCLI上の対話フローやファイル編集操作に関しても、独自のフック機構やカスタムコマンド体系を備え、利便性の向上が図られています。セキュリティ面では、本家Codexがサンドボックスとユーザー承認機構によって外部アクセスや書き込みを制限しているのに対し 、zapabob版Codexではセキュリティプロファイルの概念導入や包括的なサンドボックス逸脱テストによって、より細かな信頼性設定とログ監査が追加されています 。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n以上を踏まえ、本仕様書では本家Codexのコードベースに対し、zapabob版Codexで実現された機能拡張を統合し、GUI（グラフィカルユーザインタフェース）での操作やショートカットキーによる実行、自然言語によるモード切替、DeepResearch（深層リサーチ）機能の統合、およびGit/MCP対応のエージェントオーケストレーションといった提案機能を組み込むための要件を定義します。これらの新機能を追加するにあたり、OpenAI本家のアップストリームコードベースとの互換性を確保しつつ、zapabob版での有用な改良点を可能な限り活かすことを目標とします。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 目的\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n本ドキュメントの目的は、OpenAI Codex（本家版）の既存機能とzapabob版Codexの拡張機能を統合した次世代システムの技術的要求事項を明確にすることです。開発チームおよび関係者がこの要求仕様に基づき設計・実装・テストを行えるよう、機能要件および非機能要件を網羅的に示します。特に、エージェントのオーケストレーション方式の拡充、ユーザインタフェースの刷新、操作性の向上（GUI操作・キーボードショートカット）、モード切替手段の自然言語化、DeepResearch機能の組み込み、Git連携およびOpenAI Agents SDK（Model Context Protocol, MCP）との統合に関する事項について詳細に記述します。\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"signatures\\\\\\\":{},\\\\\\\"detailedLines\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\"text\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"# zapabob/codex — Sub‑Agents &amp; DeepResearch 拡張 要件定義書（v0.1, 2025‑11‑01, JST）\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 1. 背景・現状認識（コードベースレビュー）\\\\\\\\n- **ベース**は &#96;openai/codex&#96; の最新メインブランチ（0.53.0, Oct 31, 2025）。Rust中心（約96%）で CLI (&#96;codex-cli&#96;) とコア (&#96;codex-rs&#96;)、Docs を含む。MCP（Model Context Protocol）対応、承認/サンドボックス、AGENTS.md（メモリ）等のドキュメントが整備されている。〔参照: README, Languages, MCP, Sandbox &amp; approvals〕\\\\\\\\n- zapabob による **上流PR活動**の痕跡（meta‑orchestration/parallel agent 等）あり。〔参照: GitHub Actions の run logs / PR #5108 連動〕\\\\\\\\n- 競合プロダクト：**Claude Code**のサブエージェント（専用プロンプト＋ツール＋独立コンテキスト）、**Gemini CLI**（オープンソース CLI、MCP/検索連携、GitHub Actions 統合の報道/OSS）。これらは**研究/検索のネイティブ統合**や**エージェント分業**を強化している。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&gt; 本要件は **openai/codex の構造とAPIに追従**しつつ、zapabob/codex 側で **サブエージェント群** と **DeepResearch（検索拡張）** を追加する前提。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n---\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 2. 目的・非目的\\\\\\\\n**目的**\\\\\\\\n1) Codex に 競合回避/選抜）を強化。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**非目的**\\\\\\\\n- LLM 推論エンジン自体の改変（モデル切替は設定で）。\\\\\\\\n- IDE プラグインの再実装（CLI から利用可能な範囲に限定）。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n---\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 3. 機能要件（FR）\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### FR-1 endLine=\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"11\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"&gt;\\\\\\\\n     1|# Codex機能拡張統合の要求仕様書\\\\\\\\n     2|\\\\\\\\n     3|## 背景\\\\\\\\n     4|\\\\\\\\n     5|OpenAIが提供する「Codex」は、ターミナル上で動作する軽量のコーディングエージェントであり、対話を通じてコードの生成・編集やテスト実行など開発支援を行います 。現行のOpenAI版Codex（以下「本家Codex」）は、VS CodeやCursorといったIDEとの連携、GitHubプルリクエストレビュー機能、シングルスレッドでの非同期タスク実行、Web/ターミナル統合といった基本機能を備えています 。一方で、コミュニティにおける派生版であるzapabob氏のCodex（以下「zapabob版Codex」）では、本家Codexにはない高度な機能拡張が多数実装されています 。主な相違点として、zapabob版Codexはエージェントのオーケストレーション（編成管理）方法に革新的な改良が加えられており、複数エージェントの並列実行や動的生成、エージェント自身による自己呼び出し（メタオーケストレーション）などを可能にしています 。またCLI上の対話フローやファイル編集操作に関しても、独自のフック機構やカスタムコマンド体系を備え、利便性の向上が図られています。セキュリティ面では、本家Codexがサンドボックスとユーザー承認機構によって外部アクセスや書き込みを制限しているのに対し 、zapabob版Codexではセキュリティプロファイルの概念導入や包括的なサンドボックス逸脱テストによって、より細かな信頼性設定とログ監査が追加されています 。\\\\\\\\n     6|\\\\\\\\n     7|以上を踏まえ、本仕様書では本家Codexのコードベースに対し、zapabob版Codexで実現された機能拡張を統合し、GUI（グラフィカルユーザインタフェース）での操作やショートカットキーによる実行、自然言語によるモード切替、DeepResearch（深層リサーチ）機能の統合、およびGit/MCP対応のエージェントオーケストレーションといった提案機能を組み込むための要件を定義します。これらの新機能を追加するにあたり、OpenAI本家のアップストリームコードベースとの互換性を確保しつつ、zapabob版での有用な改良点を可能な限り活かすことを目標とします。\\\\\\\\n     8|\\\\\\\\n     9|## 目的\\\\\\\\n    10|\\\\\\\\n    11|本ドキュメントの目的は、OpenAI Codex（本家版）の既存機能とzapabob版Codexの拡張機能を統合した次世代システムの技術的要求事項を明確にすることです。開発チームおよび関係者がこの要求仕様に基づき設計・実装・テストを行えるよう、機能要件および非機能要件を網羅的に示します。特に、エージェントのオーケストレーション方式の拡充、ユーザインタフェースの刷新、操作性の向上（GUI操作・キーボードショートカット）、モード切替手段の自然言語化、DeepResearch機能の組み込み、Git連携およびOpenAI Agents SDK（Model Context Protocol, MCP）との統合に関する事項について詳細に記述します。\\\\\\\\n&lt;/search_result&gt;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&lt;search_result Codex機能拡張統合の要求仕様書\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 背景\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nOpenAIが提供する「Codex」は、ターミナル上で動作する軽量のコーディングエージェントであり、対話を通じてコードの生成・編集やテスト実行など開発支援を行います 。現行のOpenAI版Codex（以下「本家Codex」）は、VS CodeやCursorといったIDEとの連携、GitHubプルリクエストレビュー機能、シングルスレッドでの非同期タスク実行、Web/ターミナル統合といった基本機能を備えています 。一方で、コミュニティにおける派生版であるzapabob氏のCodex（以下「zapabob版Codex」）では、本家Codexにはない高度な機能拡張が多数実装されています 。主な相違点として、zapabob版Codexはエージェントのオーケストレーション（編成管理）方法に革新的な改良が加えられており、複数エージェントの並列実行や動的生成、エージェント自身による自己呼び出し（メタオーケストレーション）などを可能にしています 。またCLI上の対話フローやファイル編集操作に関しても、独自のフック機構やカスタムコマンド体系を備え、利便性の向上が図られています。セキュリティ面では、本家Codexがサンドボックスとユーザー承認機構によって外部アクセスや書き込みを制限しているのに対し 、zapabob版Codexではセキュリティプロファイルの概念導入や包括的なサンドボックス逸脱テストによって、より細かな信頼性設定とログ監査が追加されています 。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n以上を踏まえ、本仕様書では本家Codexのコードベースに対し、zapabob版Codexで実現された機能拡張を統合し、GUI（グラフィカルユーザインタフェース）での操作やショートカットキーによる実行、自然言語によるモード切替、DeepResearch（深層リサーチ）機能の統合、およびGit/MCP対応のエージェントオーケストレーションといった提案機能を組み込むための要件を定義します。これらの新機能を追加するにあたり、OpenAI本家のアップストリームコードベースとの互換性を確保しつつ、zapabob版での有用な改良点を可能な限り活かすことを目標とします。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 目的\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n本ドキュメントの目的は、OpenAI Codex（本家版）の既存機能とzapabob版Codexの拡張機能を統合した次世代システムの技術的要求事項を明確にすることです。開発チームおよび関係者がこの要求仕様に基づき設計・実装・テストを行えるよう、機能要件および非機能要件を網羅的に示します。特に、エージェントのオーケストレーション方式の拡充、ユーザインタフェースの刷新、操作性の向上（GUI操作・キーボードショートカット）、モード切替手段の自然言語化、DeepResearch機能の組み込み、Git連携およびOpenAI Agents SDK（Model Context Protocol, MCP）との統合に関する事項について詳細に記述します。\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"signatures\\\\\\\":{},\\\\\\\"detailedLines\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\"text\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"# zapabob/codex — Sub‑Agents &amp; DeepResearch 拡張 要件定義書（v0.1, 2025‑11‑01, JST）\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 1. 背景・現状認識（コードベースレビュー）\\\\\\\\n- **ベース**は &#96;openai/codex&#96; の最新メインブランチ（0.53.0, Oct 31, 2025）。Rust中心（約96%）で CLI (&#96;codex-cli&#96;) とコア (&#96;codex-rs&#96;)、Docs を含む。MCP（Model Context Protocol）対応、承認/サンドボックス、AGENTS.md（メモリ）等のドキュメントが整備されている。〔参照: README, Languages, MCP, Sandbox &amp; approvals〕\\\\\\\\n- zapabob による **上流PR活動**の痕跡（meta‑orchestration/parallel agent 等）あり。〔参照: GitHub Actions の run logs / PR #5108 連動〕\\\\\\\\n- 競合プロダクト：**Claude Code**のサブエージェント（専用プロンプト＋ツール＋独立コンテキスト）、**Gemini CLI**（オープンソース CLI、MCP/検索連携、GitHub Actions 統合の報道/OSS）。これらは**研究/検索のネイティブ統合**や**エージェント分業**を強化している。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&gt; 本要件は **openai/codex の構造とAPIに追従**しつつ、zapabob/codex 側で **サブエージェント群** と **DeepResearch（検索拡張）** を追加する前提。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n---\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 2. 目的・非目的\\\\\\\\n**目的**\\\\\\\\n1) Codex に **タスク特化サブエージェント**をネイティブ実装（並列実行＋合議統合）。  \\\\\\\\n2) MCP ベースの **DeepResearch**（検索→要約→根拠スコア→引用出力）を公式検索機能の拡張として提供。  \\\\\\\\n3) **安全性・再現性**（承認フロー、監査ログ、決定記録）と **Git 連携**（worktree 競合回避/選抜）を強化。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**非目的**\\\\\\\\n- LLM 推論エンジン自体の改変（モデル切替は設定で）。\\\\\\\\n- IDE プラグインの再実装（CLI から利用可能な範囲に限定）。\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n---\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 3. 機能要件（FR）\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### FR-1 サブエージェント基盤\\\\\\\\n- 役割プリセット：&#96;researcher&#96;, &#96;architect&#96;, &#96;executor&#96;, &#96;tester&#96;, &#96;sec-auditor&#96;, &#96;refactorer&#96;。  \\\\\\\\n- **独立コンテキスト**（各自メモリ/Scratchpad）と **専用ツール権限**（MCP/FS/Net）をプロファイルで定義。  \\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"signatures\\\\\\\":{},\\\\\\\"detailedLines\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\"text\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"# zapabob/codex — Sub‑Agents &amp; DeepResearch 拡張 要件定義書（v0.1, align=\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"center\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"&gt;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v2.5.1-blue)](./docs/v2.5.1_Release_Details.md)\\\\\\\\n[![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-2024-orange)](https://www.rust-lang.org/)\\\\\\\\n[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/typescript-5.0-blue)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)\\\\\\\\n[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-lightgrey)](./INSTALL.md)\\\\\\\\n[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-green)](./LICENSE)\\\\\\\\n[![CUDA](https://img.shields.io/badge/CUDA-12.0+-76B900?logo=nvidia)](./docs/cuda/)\\\\\\\\n[![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Protocol-blueviolet)](./docs/mcp/)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**🚀 Next-generation AI coding assistant featuring high-performance parallel execution, industrial-grade security sandboxing, and autonomous multi-agent orchestration.**  \\\\\\\\n**🚀 次世代AIコーディングアシスタント：高性能並列実行、産業グレードのセキュリティサンドボックス、自律型マルチエージェントオーケストレーションを搭載。**\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n[🇺🇸 English](#-english) | [🇯🇵 日本語](#-japanese)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&lt;/div&gt;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n---\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## 🇺🇸 English\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🎯 What is Codex?\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n**Codex** is an **advanced AI orchestration platform** designed for enterprise-grade autonomous software engineering. It transforms AI from a simple chat interface into a powerful, multi-agent development environment.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nKey pillars of this project include:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **⚡ Rust 2024 Core** - State-of-the-art memory safety and high-concurrency performance.\\\\\\\\n- **🔒 Zero-Trust Sandboxing** - Secure isolation with strict ACLs and audit trails.\\\\\\\\n- **🤖 Autonomous Swarms** - Parallel sub-agents (Backend, QA, Frontend) with A2A coordination.\\\\\\\\n- **🎮 Immersive Repositories** - Git4D 3D visualization with VR/AR support.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🌟 Latest in v2.5.1 (Unique &amp; Official Features)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nWe emphasize **technical excellence** and **innovation** by integrating the best of official features with our unique competitive additions.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Swarm Intelligence**: Real-time coordination and self-correction during development.\\\\\\\\n- **Codex GUI-X**: Next-gen frontend built with **Next.js 15**, **React 19**, and **3D visualization**.\\\\\\\\n- **Git Worktree Orchestration**: Parallel feature development managed directly by AI agents.\\\\\\\\n- **QC Optimization Competition**: Benchmarking LLM outputs to select the most optimal code path.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🚀 Technical Excellence Stack\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n| Component        | Technology        | Impact                                               |\\\\\\\\n| ---------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |\\\\\\\\n| **Backend**      | Rust 2024 / Tokio | Sub-millisecond latency &amp; thread-safe orchestration. |\\\\\\\\n| **Frontend**     | Next.js 15 / MUI  | Real-time telemetry &amp; intuitive AI interaction.      |\\\\\\\\n| **AI Protocol**  | MCP 1.0           | Extensible tool-use across any LLM provider.         |\\\\\\\\n| **Acceleration** | CUDA 12 / GPU     | 3.7x faster codebase analysis &amp; \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"https://api.github.com/repos/openai/codex/zipball/rust-v0.104.0\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"body\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"## New Features\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Added &#96;WS_PROXY&#96;/&#96;WSS_PROXY&#96; environment support (including lowercase variants) for websocket proxying in the network proxy. (#11784)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- App-server v2 now emits notifications when threads are archived or unarchived, enabling clients to react without polling. (#12030)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Protocol/core now carry distinct approval IDs for command approvals to support multiple approvals within a single shell command execution flow. (#12051)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Bug Fixes\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- &#96;Ctrl+C&#96;/&#96;Ctrl+D&#96; now cleanly exits the cwd-change prompt during resume/fork flows instead of implicitly selecting an option. (#12040)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Reduced false-positive safety-check downgrade behavior by relying on the response header model (and websocket top-level events) rather than the response body model slug. (#12061)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Documentation\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Updated docs and schemas to cover websocket proxy configuration, new thread archive/unarchive notifications, and the command approval ID plumbing. (#11784, #12030, #12051)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Chores\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Made the Rust release workflow resilient to &#96;npm publish&#96; attempts for an already-published version. (#12044)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Standardized remote compaction test mocking and refreshed related snapshots to align with the default production-shaped behavior. (#12050)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Changelog\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nFull Changelog: \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"https://api.github.com/repos/openai/codex/zipball/rust-v0.104.0\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\\n \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"body\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"## New Features\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Added &#96;WS_PROXY&#96;/&#96;WSS_PROXY&#96; environment support (including lowercase variants) for websocket proxying in the network proxy. (#11784)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- App-server v2 now emits notifications when threads are archived or unarchived, enabling clients to react without polling. (#12030)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Protocol/core now carry distinct approval IDs for command approvals to support multiple approvals within a single shell command execution flow. (#12051)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Bug Fixes\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- &#96;Ctrl+C&#96;/&#96;Ctrl+D&#96; now cleanly exits the cwd-change prompt during resume/fork flows instead of implicitly selecting an option. (#12040)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Reduced false-positive safety-check downgrade behavior by relying on the response header model (and websocket top-level events) rather than the response body model slug. (#12061)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Documentation\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Updated docs and schemas to cover websocket proxy configuration, new thread archive/unarchive notifications, and the command approval ID plumbing. (#11784, #12030, #12051)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Chores\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Made the Rust release workflow resilient to &#96;npm publish&#96; attempts for an already-published version. (#12044)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n- Standardized remote compaction test mocking and refreshed related snapshots to align with the default production-shaped behavior. (#12050)\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n## Changelog\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\nFull Changelog: Fix** - Resolved DNS rebinding vulnerability in network proxy\\\\\\\\n- **Sandbox Bypass Fix** - Fixed sandbox bypass vulnerability\\\\\\\\n- **Exec Policy Path Confusion** - Resolved path confusion in exec policy\\\\\\\\n- **Case-Insensitivity Vulnerability** - Fixed case-insensitive matching exploit\\\\\\\\n- **Git Command Safety** - Removed git commands from dangerous command checks\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🐛 Fixed (from upstream)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **NUX Display** - Don't show NUX for upgrade-target models that are hidden\\\\\\\\n- **App Loading Logic** - Fixed app loading sequence\\\\\\\\n- **TUI Improvements** - Delta streaming, compaction events, approvals UI\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 📦 Preserved Custom Features (zapabob)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- &#96;codex-gui-x/&#96; - Custom GUI implementation\\\\\\\\n- &#96;prism-mcp-server/&#96;, &#96;prism-web/&#96; - Prism MCP integrations\\\\\\\\n- WebXR Git visualization with cyberpunk effects\\\\\\\\n- AI tool orchestration (task distribution, result integration)\\\\\\\\n- Bilingual README and GH Pages\\\\\\\\n- Fast build system and hot reload installation\\\\\\\\n- CI/CD customizations and release packaging\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### 🔧 Technical Details\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n- **Merge Strategy**: &#96;git merge upstream/main&#96; with Python-automated conflict resolution\\\\\\\\n- **Conflicts Resolved**: 4. **Python conflict resolution** - write and run a Python script to resolve conflicts
5. **Manual review of critical conflicts** - especially in Cargo.toml and core modules
6. **Version bump** - bump from 2.16.0 → 2.17.0
7. **Dependency updates** - update pnpm (CVE-2026-24842), update Rust dependencies
8. **Build & test** - verify everything compiles
9. **Update CHANGELOG.md** - document the merge and changes
10. **Save implementation log to `_docs/`** - record the process for future reference

The Python script will walk through conflicted files and intelligently resolve them by preferring upstream changes for version bumps and configuration while preserving any custom features in source code. Since we're syncing 163 upstream commits with security fixes, bumping to 2.17.0 as a minor version makes sense.</details></think>
